basic_info.description: Modern & Elegant 2-Story/3BD/2BA Semi-Detached Single-Family Home in the Desirable Sunset Neighborhood! It features direct Golden Gate Bridge view from the bedroom. This beautifully designed home offers a perfect blend of modern elegance and functionality. Behind its sleek facade, you'll find natural hardwood floors flowing effortlessly throughout the open, airy layout, enhanced by abundant natural light. The main level features a sun-drenched south-facing spacious living room, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The gourmet eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, complete with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances. Also on this level are two spacious bedrooms and an updated full bath. The lower level done with city permits with new electric and new plumbing offers a third bedroom, a second bath, and a family room with a separate entrance. Additional features include a one-car garage with storage space, an installed washer/dryer, and an EV charging plug(220V) ready for your electric vehicle. Conveniently located near public transportation, top-ranked schools, tech shuttles, Safeway, Noriega St, 19th Ave and various restaurants and shops, this home is a must-see!
